Shipping

# Ships internationally from China
Policy dated August 28, 2026. Methods and charges appear at checkout on shop.cnps.ai after a delivery address is entered.

CNPS.AI ships only to destinations that are available when you enter your delivery address at checkout. A country appearing in the market list does not guarantee that every product or carrier service is available to every address.
Orders may be shipped internationally from China. Currency on the shop is USD. Import duties, taxes, customs charges, brokerage fees, and local handling charges may apply. Unless checkout explicitly states that duties or taxes are included, these charges are the recipient's responsibility.
Many products contain lithium batteries or wireless components. Carrier or destination-country restrictions can limit a shipping method or prevent shipment.
